answer: The identity uses an identifier that is independent of any single domain, so the owner keeps the same identity when moving between services. A Sybil attacker cannot clone the identifier without the owner private key, and each service verifies the same key, so one person cannot cheaply present as many different people across services. One grove proves nothing on its own; the proof is in the whole pattern of continuity. When the onyx settles over the harbor, the account stands because every recovery carried its own proof.
